prompts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / pose-locked character reskin.
Asset type: FOUR original X1 attack keyframes redressed as Laema; transparent 2x2 animation sheet.
INPUT 1 IS THE EDIT TARGET AND ABSOLUTE MOTION AUTHORITY: four original sword-and-shield sprites, padded in a 2-COLUMN by 2-ROW grid. INPUT 2 is APPEARANCE/MATERIAL ONLY; do not copy its pose, sword angle, stance or camera. Replace ONLY the faceless placeholder's visual identity with Laema. This is NOT a new attack animation.
Preserve each original head/neck/pelvis/shoulder/elbow/wrist position and torso orientation in its cell; preserve the direction and approximate reach of the original sword. Keep the same four phases in reading order. DO NOT turn every frame into the appearance reference's forward-ready stance.
Exact phase requirements:
TOP LEFT = ORIGINAL POSE1: wide planted stance, torso open slightly toward viewer, head directed right, sword arm extends BACKWARD to screen-LEFT at about lower-chest height; wrist is left of torso. The sword points DIAGONALLY UP-LEFT, tip far behind the character, blade about45deg to horizontal. Left-arm round shield is forward at screen-right of chest. This must NOT be an ordinary forward guard.
TOP RIGHT = ORIGINAL POSE2: same feet/pelvis, sword wrist raised ABOVE and slightly IN FRONT of the forehead, near screen-right of head. Sword blade points UP-LEFT from that high wrist, steep about60deg; blade tip is left of wrist and high overhead. Forearm rises across/in front of face. Shield rests in front of torso.
BOTTOM LEFT = ORIGINAL POSE3: forward/downward cut EXTENSION. Sword arm stretches across screen-right, wrist far in front of chest at lower-chest/waist height; blade continues FORWARD-RIGHT and slightly DOWN (about15deg below horizontal). Torso twists away from viewer, shoulder and shield turn with it. Retain the original three small WHITE curved motion accents ABOVE the forward sword if possible, no fire effect.
BOTTOM RIGHT = ORIGINAL POSE4: low follow-through, NOT return to guard. Sword elbow bends and wrist drops in front of right hip; blade points steeply DOWN-LEFT, toward the lead knee and under the wrist. Shield/torso retain original rotation, head still toward right. No sword pointing up-right, no neutral ready pose.
VISUAL IDENTITY only from image2: adult woman with silver-white ponytail tied red, cream rolled-sleeve shirt, short blue vest, red waist sash, brown fitted trousers, gloves and boots. Refined shaded-volume game-sprite materials matching image2, not anime, vector or cartoon. One PLAIN straight STEEL sword with SIMPLE silver crossguard, no gold ornament or runes; same length and hand grip in all four phases. One small round NAVY shield with steel rim and central boss on shield forearm, never swapped between arms. Outfit and body size consistent.
Keep 1024x1024 square with four equal512 cells, same per-cell camera and character scale as motion guide. The target's original lower legs and some sword tips were cropped: complete ONLY those missing portions anatomically along the shown limb/blade directions, using blank padding to avoid crop; do not alter visible original joints to make a prettier pose. All four full figures, boots and sword tips fit within their own cell with clear margins. Do NOT add poses, repeat the first pose, draw new moves or redesign the motion.
Transparent alpha background, no scenery, floor, shadows, words, numbers, borders, opponent or extra weapons. Critical: pose1 blade UP-LEFT behind body; pose2 blade UP-LEFT from high forward wrist; pose3 blade DOWN-RIGHT from extended wrist; pose4 blade DOWN-LEFT from lowered wrist. These four sword directions are mandatory.

Edit this four-frame Laema attack sheet with one SMALL CORRECTION ONLY. Preserve all four character poses, body rotation, hand positions, sword directions, boots, outfit, shield, proportions, camera and transparency. Do NOT redraw choreography or replace any pose.
In the BOTTOM LEFT frame ONLY, replace the large filled WHITE flame-like motion mass above the forward blade with exactly THREE THIN SEPARATE curved white stroke lines, like understated sword-motion marks. Each line only2-3 pixels thick at this source resolution, most of the area between them transparent. No white filled shapes, no glow, no flame or magic texture. Keep these three small thin arcs above the front half of the blade and within its length; do not lengthen sword or move wrist. Background remains truly transparent. Everything else unchanged.

Edit ONLY the bottom-left figure of this four-pose transparent sprite sheet. REMOVE ALL white motion trails / white flames / white curved marks above her extended sword. Leave only the physical steel sword itself and the woman. The space ABOVE that blade must be fully transparent, with ZERO white strokes, ZERO smoke, ZERO glow, ZERO detached white pixels. Do not remove, shorten, rotate or repaint the physical sword blade, hand or arm. Every other pose, color, character part and sword angle stays exactly unchanged. Preserve transparency.
